$comment: What each release holds. Every package is a zip asset, built from one Unity module installed for that Unity version. Adding a package, or changing one, makes the next run (re)build that asset in every release it applies to; the others stay as they are.

packages.description: Unity's managed libraries from the Windows x64 IL2CPP player, for unstripping Windows IL2CPP games.
Unity's managed libraries from the Linux x64 IL2CPP player, for unstripping Linux IL2CPP games.
